---
title: "04 - Pairwise cohort analysis with within-ancestry negative controls"
author: "Shuai Guo"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

Every estimate here is computed from **exactly two cohorts**, so no pooling of
heterogeneous datasets contributes to any point.

The four cohorts with enough tumours in both smoking strata give six pairs:
four cross-ancestry and two within-ancestry. The within-ancestry pairs are
**negative controls**. A technical difference between two independently
processed datasets should appear in any pair, whereas an ancestry effect should
appear only when the pair spans the ancestry boundary. This answers R1-1 and
R2-6 without requiring us to model technical variables the cohorts do not report.

The test is deliberately falsifiable and is expected to reject endpoints that
depend on absolute mutation counts.

**A note on power.** With four cross-ancestry and two within-ancestry pairs the
smallest attainable two-sided rank-sum P value is 2/15 = 0.133, so this test
cannot reach P < 0.05 by construction. Complete separation, meaning the smallest
cross-ancestry absolute effect exceeds the largest within-ancestry one, is the
informative statistic; the P value is not.

```{r setup}
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  source("_functions.R")

  dir.create("../results/04_cohort_pairs/tables", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create("../results/04_cohort_pairs/figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create("../results/figure1_panels", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  n_boot = 2000
  set.seed(20260809)

  meta = load_metadata(drop_ancestry = TRUE, drop_hyper = FALSE)
  meta = meta[meta$Cohort %in% PER_COHORT_SET, ]
  cohorts = PER_COHORT_SET
  cohort_group = c(Chen2020 = "EAS", Xu2020 = "EAS",
                   TCGA2014 = "Western", TRACERx2023 = "Western")

  pair_a = c()
  pair_b = c()
  for (i in 1:(length(cohorts) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):length(cohorts)) {
      a = cohorts[i]
      b = cohorts[j]
      if (cohort_group[a] == "Western" && cohort_group[b] == "EAS") {
        a = cohorts[j]
        b = cohorts[i]
      }
      pair_a = c(pair_a, a)
      pair_b = c(pair_b, b)
    }
  }
  pair_class = rep("cross-ancestry", length(pair_a))
  same = cohort_group[pair_a] == cohort_group[pair_b]
  pair_class[same] = paste0("within-", cohort_group[pair_a][same])
  data.frame(pair_a, pair_b, pair_class)

  sig_wide = load_signature_relative()
  sig_meta = merge(meta, sig_wide, by = "SampleID")
  sig_list = active_signatures(sig_wide)
  point_class = load_point_mutation_classes()
  point_meta = merge(meta, point_class, by = "SampleID")
  classes = c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")
```

# 1. Pairwise difference in differences, every continuous layer

The EAS cohort is placed first in cross-ancestry pairs, so a positive value
means the Western cohort has the steeper response to smoking.

```{r pairwise-did}
  pw = NULL
  for (k in seq_along(pair_a)) {
    a = pair_a[k]
    b = pair_b[k]
    d = meta[meta$HasTMB, ]
    r = pairwise_did(d$NonsynonymousPerMb, d$Cohort, d$Smoking, a, b, "TMB", n_boot)
    if (!is.null(r)) {
      r$layer = "TMB"
      r$pair_class = pair_class[k]
      pw = rbind(pw, r)
    }
    for (i in seq_along(sig_list)) {
      r = pairwise_did(sig_meta[[sig_list[i]]], sig_meta$Cohort, sig_meta$Smoking,
                       a, b, sig_list[i], n_boot)
      if (!is.null(r)) {
        r$layer = "signature"
        r$pair_class = pair_class[k]
        pw = rbind(pw, r)
      }
    }
    for (i in seq_along(classes)) {
      r = pairwise_did(point_meta[[classes[i]]], point_meta$Cohort,
                       point_meta$Smoking, a, b, classes[i], n_boot)
      if (!is.null(r)) {
        r$layer = "substitution class"
        r$pair_class = pair_class[k]
        pw = rbind(pw, r)
      }
    }
  }
  pw$p_adjusted = NA
  feats = unique(pw$feature)
  for (i in seq_along(feats)) {
    rows = pw$feature == feats[i]
    pw$p_adjusted[rows] = p.adjust(pw$p_bootstrap[rows], method = "BH")
  }
  write.csv(pw, "../results/04_cohort_pairs/tables/01_pairwise_did.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("pairwise estimates:", nrow(pw), " over", length(feats), "features\n")
  pw[pw$feature == "SBS4", c("cohort_a", "cohort_b", "pair_class", "delta_a",
                             "delta_b", "did", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_adjusted")]
```

# 2. Do cross-ancestry and within-ancestry pairs separate?

```{r separation}
  sep = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(feats)) {
    d = pw[pw$feature == feats[i], ]
    cross = abs(d$did[d$pair_class == "cross-ancestry"])
    within = abs(d$did[d$pair_class != "cross-ancestry"])
    if (length(cross) < 2 || length(within) < 1) {
      next
    }
    layer = d$layer[1]
    tst = wilcox.test(cross, within)
    sep = rbind(sep, data.frame(feature = feats[i], layer = layer,
      n_cross = length(cross), n_within = length(within),
      median_cross = median(cross), median_within = median(within),
      min_cross = min(cross), max_within = max(within),
      complete_separation = min(cross) > max(within),
      p_value = tst$p.value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  sep = sep[order(-sep$complete_separation, -sep$median_cross), ]
  write.csv(sep, "../results/04_cohort_pairs/tables/02_class_separation.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("features with complete separation:", sum(sep$complete_separation), "of",
      nrow(sep), "\n")
  sep[sep$complete_separation | sep$feature %in% c("TMB", "SBS1", "SBS4", "C>A"), ]
```

```{r separation-figure}
  pw$class2 = "within-ancestry"
  pw$class2[pw$pair_class == "cross-ancestry"] = "cross-ancestry"
  pw$abs_did = abs(pw$did)
  scaled = rep(NA, nrow(pw))
  for (i in seq_along(feats)) {
    rows = pw$feature == feats[i]
    mx = max(pw$abs_did[rows], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (mx > 0) {
      scaled[rows] = pw$abs_did[rows] / mx
    }
  }
  pw$scaled = scaled
  show = pw[pw$feature %in% c("TMB", "SBS4", "SBS1", "SBS2", "SBS13", "C>A",
                              "C>T", "T>C"), ]
  ordf = sep$feature[sep$feature %in% show$feature]
  show$feature = factor(show$feature, levels = ordf)
  p_sep = ggplot(show, aes(x = feature, y = scaled, colour = class2))
  p_sep = p_sep + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1,
                                                            dodge.width = 0.55),
                             size = 2, alpha = 0.9)
  p_sep = p_sep + scale_colour_manual(values = c("cross-ancestry" = "#C0392B",
                                                 "within-ancestry" = "#3B6FB6"),
                                      name = NULL)
  p_sep = p_sep + labs(x = NULL,
                       y = "absolute DiD, scaled to the maximum for that feature",
                       title = "Only endpoints that respect the ancestry boundary separate")
  p_sep = p_sep + theme_pub()
  p_sep = p_sep + theme(legend.position = "top")
  ggsave("../results/04_cohort_pairs/figures/class_separation.pdf", p_sep,
         width = 6, height = 3.6, device = cairo_pdf)
  p_sep
```

```{r pairwise-forest}
  show = pw[pw$feature %in% c("SBS4", "TMB", "C>A", "SBS1", "SBS13"), ]
  show$pair = paste(sub("2014|2019|2020|2023", "", show$cohort_a),
                    sub("2014|2019|2020|2023", "", show$cohort_b), sep = " / ")
  ord = show$pair[show$feature == "SBS4"][order(show$did[show$feature == "SBS4"])]
  show$pair = factor(show$pair, levels = ord)
  show$feature = factor(show$feature, levels = c("SBS4", "C>A", "TMB", "SBS1", "SBS13"))
  p_pw = forest_plot(show, "did", "ci_low", "ci_high", "pair", "pair_class",
                     CLASS_COLS, "difference in differences (95% CI)",
                     "Every estimate uses exactly two cohorts; within-ancestry pairs are controls")
  p_pw = p_pw + facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1)
  ggsave("../results/04_cohort_pairs/figures/pairwise_forest.pdf", p_pw,
         width = 10, height = 3.2, device = cairo_pdf)
  p_pw
```

# 3. Driver genes, pairwise within each smoking stratum (Figure 1D, right)

```{r pairwise-drivers}
  driver_meta = meta[meta$HasFullMAF, ]
  snv_pa = load_protein_altering(cohorts)
  gene_tab = table(snv_pa$Gene[snv_pa$SampleID %in% driver_meta$SampleID])
  test_genes = names(gene_tab)[gene_tab >= MIN_GENE_MUTATED]
  cat("genes tested per pair per stratum:", length(test_genes), "\n")

  pwd = NULL
  for (k in seq_along(pair_a)) {
    a = pair_a[k]
    b = pair_b[k]
    for (sm in c("Never", "Ever")) {
      da = driver_meta[driver_meta$Cohort == a & driver_meta$Smoking == sm, ]
      db = driver_meta[driver_meta$Cohort == b & driver_meta$Smoking == sm, ]
      if (nrow(da) < 10 || nrow(db) < 10) {
        next
      }
      for (i in seq_along(test_genes)) {
        ha = da$SampleID %in% snv_pa$SampleID[snv_pa$Gene == test_genes[i]]
        hb = db$SampleID %in% snv_pa$SampleID[snv_pa$Gene == test_genes[i]]
        if (sum(ha) + sum(hb) < 3) {
          next
        }
        tab = matrix(c(sum(ha), length(ha) - sum(ha),
                       sum(hb), length(hb) - sum(hb)), nrow = 2)
        odds = ((sum(ha) + 0.5) * (length(hb) - sum(hb) + 0.5))
        odds = odds / ((length(ha) - sum(ha) + 0.5) * (sum(hb) + 0.5))
        pwd = rbind(pwd, data.frame(feature = test_genes[i], smoking = sm,
          cohort_a = a, cohort_b = b, pair_class = pair_class[k],
          n_a = length(ha), freq_a = mean(ha),
          n_b = length(hb), freq_b = mean(hb),
          log2_odds_ratio = log2(odds), p_value = fisher.test(tab)$p.value,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
      }
    }
  }
  pwd$p_adjusted = p.adjust(pwd$p_value, method = "BH")
  write.csv(pwd, "../results/04_cohort_pairs/tables/03_pairwise_driver.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)

  tally = NULL
  keys = unique(paste(pwd$cohort_a, pwd$cohort_b, pwd$smoking))
  for (i in seq_along(keys)) {
    parts = strsplit(keys[i], " ")[[1]]
    d = pwd[pwd$cohort_a == parts[1] & pwd$cohort_b == parts[2] &
            pwd$smoking == parts[3], ]
    tally = rbind(tally, data.frame(cohort_a = parts[1], cohort_b = parts[2],
      pair_class = d$pair_class[1], smoking = parts[3], n_tested = nrow(d),
      n_significant = sum(d$p_adjusted < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  tally = tally[order(tally$pair_class, tally$smoking), ]
  write.csv(tally, "../results/04_cohort_pairs/tables/04_driver_hits_by_pair.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  tally
```

```{r pairwise-driver-figure}
  show = pwd[pwd$feature %in% c("EGFR", "KRAS", "KEAP1", "TP53", "STK11"), ]
  show$pair = paste(sub("2014|2019|2020|2023", "", show$cohort_a),
                    sub("2014|2019|2020|2023", "", show$cohort_b), sep = " / ")
  show$sig = show$p_adjusted < 0.05
  p_pd = ggplot(show, aes(x = log2_odds_ratio, y = pair, colour = pair_class))
  p_pd = p_pd + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3,
                           colour = "grey40")
  p_pd = p_pd + geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2.1)
  p_pd = p_pd + facet_grid(smoking ~ feature)
  p_pd = p_pd + scale_colour_manual(values = CLASS_COLS, name = NULL)
  p_pd = p_pd + scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
                                   labels = c("ns", "adj P < 0.05"), name = NULL)
  p_pd = p_pd + labs(x = expression(log[2] * " odds ratio"), y = NULL,
                     title = "Driver differences appear only across the ancestry boundary")
  p_pd = p_pd + theme_pub()
  p_pd = p_pd + theme(legend.position = "top")
  ggsave("../results/figure1_panels/fig1d_right_cohort_pairs.pdf", p_pd,
         width = 9, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  p_pd
```
